column1: # Re-upload manifest — overwrite these S3 keys IN PLACE with the re-encoded
# local files. Same keys means the hosted HTML needs no change at all.
# hero-video.mp4 is already short-GOP and is NOT in this list.
# Upload with (needs awscli + credentials for the bucket):
#   grep -v '^#' s3-reupload.tsv | grep . | while IFS=$'\t' read -r f k; do
# The Cache-Control header is worth adding: the objects currently send none, so
# browsers only heuristically cache them and the boot loader re-downloads the
# flight far more often than it needs to.
# The 17 mobile encodes (assets/sNN-m.mp4) are NOT in this list because they
# have no S3 keys yet. Upload them under any keys you like, then add
# data-src-mobile="<url>" to each matching <video class="wh-scene"> in
# wisehealth-updated.html — index.html already has this wired to local paths
# and shows the exact attribute placement.
